'''''Galium lucidum''''' is a species of plants in the [[Rubiaceae]]. It is native to the [[Mediterranean region]], from [[Portugal]] and [[Morocco]] to [[Greece]], the range extending northwards into [[Germany]].<ref name="nancyfagan">[https://apps.kew.org/wcsp/namedetail.do?name_id=86729 Kew World Checklist of Selected Plant Families]</ref><ref>[https://luirig.altervista.org/flora/taxa/index1.php?scientific-name=galium+lucidum AltervistaFlora Italiana, Caglio lucido]</ref>

''Galium lucidum'' is an erect, perennial, [[glabrousness (botany)|glabrous]] plant up to 70 cm tall. Leaves are narrow and linear, up to 3 cm long, [[Whorl (botany)|whorled]] with as many as 10 per [[Node (botany)|node]]. [[Inflorescence]] is a large terminal panicle of many small, white to cream-colored flowers.<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.actaplantarum.org/floraitaliae/viewtopic.php?t=5313 |title=Forum Acta Plantarum, ''Galium lucidum'' All. - Caglio lucido |access-date=2014-05-09 |archive-date=2021-11-21 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211121201531/https://www.actaplantarum.org/floraitaliae/viewtopic.php?t=5313 |url-status=dead }}</ref>

==Subspecies==
Five subspecies are currently recognized (February 2025):<ref name=powo>{{cite web |title=''Galium lucidum'' All. |url=https://powo.science.kew.org/taxon/urn:lsid:ipni.org:names:750183-1 |website=[[Plants of the World Online]] |publisher=[[Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew]] |access-date=10 February 2025}}</ref>

*''Galium lucidum'' subsp. ''corrudifolium'' {{small|(Vill.) Bonnier}} – Albania, Balearic Islands, Corsica, France, Italy, Spain, and former Yugoslavia
*''Galium lucidum'' subsp. ''fruticescens'' <small>(Cav.) O.Bolòs & Vigo </small> – central-northern and eastern [[Spain]]
*''Galium lucidum'' subsp. ''krendlii'' <small>Natali</small> - [[Corsica]]
*''Galium lucidum'' subsp. ''lucidum'' - most of species range
*''Galium lucidum'' subsp. ''venustum'' <small>(Jord.) Arcang</small> – [[Corsica]], [[Sicily]], [[Sardinia]], central [[Italy]]
